title: Umqhele Owaphonsela Inselelo Isibhakabhaka
intro: Emaphasejini emibuso yasendulo, igama lombusi oyedwa laba yisaga sobushiqela nokuzikhukhumeza. Lapho inceku ka-Allah ethobekile ifika iphethe izibonakaliso ezingenakuphikwa, lo mbusi onamandla wenqaba ukuzinikela eqinisweni. Namuhla, umsebenzi wakho ukuhlonza lo muntu odumile obukhosi bakhe bawa futhi isiphetho sakhe savalwa ngaphansi kwamagagasi.
clues: Ngingumbusi owesatshwa kakhulu ogama lakhe lisalokhu lizwakala njengesixwayiso eminyakeni eminingi edlule.
Ngayala abantu bonke ukuba basebenze ngamaketanga, baphakamise izikhumbuzo ezazimemezela inkazimulo yami.
Lapho isithunywa sika-Allah sifika phambi kwami ​​​​nezibonakaliso ezingenakuphikwa, ngenqaba ukukhothama futhi ngakubiza ngokuthi ubuthakathi.
Nganquma ukubulawa kwamadodana asemancane phakathi kwabantu abathunjiwe, nginethemba lokuwaphula umoya ngaphambi kokuba avuke.
Ngema phambi kwenkantolo yami ngamemezela, 'Ngiyinkosi yenu ephakeme kakhulu,' ngifuna ukukhulekelwa njengonkulunkulu.
Nginongqongqoshe wami omkhulu eceleni kwami, ngakha isakhiwo eside esihloselwe ukukhuphuka ngale kwamazulu.
verse: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed. (79:17)
